newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 4.137 billion yuan from 3.165 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was active with both head offices of state-run banks and short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, trading actively, traders said.

Around a dozen firms are issuing or listing domestic A shares on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets this week, pushing up money demand on the interbank market and making trading more active, they said.

"Non-banking financial institutions including securities houses borrowed heavily from the short-term financial centre, pushing up the volume," a trader said. "The rates are likely to move in a narrow range in active trading in the next few days."
